sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा प्रत्युवाच यमस्तदा ।एष व्यावर्तितो दण्डः प्रभविष्णुर्हि नो भवान् ।। ७.२२.४७ ॥
transliteration: evamuktastu dharmātmā pratyuvāca yamastadā ।eṣa vyāvartito daṇḍaḥ prabhaviṣṇurhi no bhavān ।। 7.22.47 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, withdraw this uplifted rod from Ravana and make my words true now, if you indeed care for the worlds.
